name: robot
notes: A walking machine on the humanoid frame: the same eighteen bones, painted as plate and gunmetal, with a lit visor across the face, plates over the chest and shoulders and pads on the knees in a colour of their own (uniform, the same white as the body) that the shooter paints in the side's colour, a dark band across the top of the chest and another between the shoulder blades, both above where a gun held in both hands lies across the chest. The plates are near white on purpose, because the shooter tints a bot by whose side it is on and a tint can only ever darken. The lamps themselves are not here: they carry the bot's health, and health is state rather than shape, so src/brain/avatar.rs draws a lit bar along each band. The deathmatch bots are drawn as this entry's three builds (robot_brawny, robot_heavy, robot_lean), which keep the bands at the same height.
